pages.text: Every drop is useful. $(thing)Hides$() (grazer/dark) craft into leather. $(thing)Glow Sinew$() → string. $(thing)Lumen Algae$() → green dye. $(thing)Wraith Membrane$() → phantom membrane. $(thing)Mire Tooth$() → bone meal. $(thing)Rootback Plate$() → iron nuggets.

$(thing)Glow Scales$() → glow pollen. $(thing)Shade Claw$() → echo dust. $(thing)Crystal Dust$() → glasspetal block. $(thing)Moonloam Clumps$() → moonloam. $(br)$(br)$(thing)Spore Sac$() & $(thing)Glowcap Spores$() brew Sporeblind; $(thing)Air Gel$(), $(thing)Glow Pollen$() and $(thing)Living Fiber$() brew the other native potions.
